question.text: How will the Agit Kabayel vs. Nelson Hysa fight end on November 28, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the way the boxing match ends between Agit Kabayel and Nelson Hysa, currently scheduled for Saturday, November 28, 2026. Please note that "other outcome" includes any other outcome, including a Hysa victory, a draw, or the boxing match for any reason not being held before November 29, 2026 (local time).

research:
The fight hasn't happened yet and is still on, set for November 28, 2026. Kabayel is a very heavy favourite: about 1/20 (-1800 to -2000) on the moneyline, and most pundits and fans pick him to win by stoppage. I couldn't find any odds on how he wins or in which round.

## 1. Resolution source
- No official results page is named. The result will come from the official outcome of the WBC heavyweight title fight at the Merkur Spiel-Arena in Düsseldorf, shown live on DAZN.
- I couldn't open the DAZN background link (HTTP 403). Its address says "IBF defence," but every other source says the WBC title is on the line. The IBF belt belongs to Filip Hrgovic.
- 2026-09/10: Queensberry's announcement confirms Kabayel (27-0, 19 KOs) vs Hysa (25-0, 23 KOs) for the WBC title on Saturday, November 28, live on DAZN. It doesn't say how many rounds; a world title fight is normally 12. [Queensberry](https://queensberry.co.uk/blogs/queensberry-promotions-blog/kabayel-v-hysa-booked-for-world-title-showdown-in-dusseldorf-live-on-dazn)

Hysa:
